result.reason: The clause satisfies the fallback and substantially reaches the preferred position: it provides a mutual cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ fees or USD 1,000,000, a mutual consequential-damages exclusion, the required fallback carve-outs plus fraud and IP infringement, and excludes Company payment obligations from the cap. It leaves the existing warranties unchanged and adds only relevant liability terms. It falls slightly short of the preferred formulation because the carve-out covers “data security” but not expressly all data protection obligations, and the fee lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself. Drafting is otherwise clear and professional, though placement within the warranties section is not ideal.
